title: Time: Time Intervals, Timetables and Units from Seconds to Centuries
seo_title: Grade 6 Time Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Read, tell and write time in 12-hour and 24-hour formats on both analogue and digital instruments in hours, minutes and seconds; use clocks, calendars, stopwatches and timetables; calculate and solve problems involving time intervals; convert between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years, decades and centuries.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 6 time worksheets: units of time, time intervals, timetables, itineraries and time problems. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Count on to the next hour first.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • 60 seconds = 1 minute, 60 minutes = 1 hour, 24 hours = 1 day; 10 years = 1 decade, 100 years = 1 century.
  • 24-hour time: 3:45 p.m. = 15:45.
  • To find a time interval, count on to the next hour, then the whole hours, then the minutes.
  • In a timetable, find the row for the place and the column for the trip.

Examples

Example

Bus leaves 08:35, arrives 11:10

08:35 → 09:00 is 25 min

09:00 → 11:00 is 2 h

+ 10 min

Answer: 2 hours 35 minutes

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
100 minutes1 hour = 60 minutes.
The wrong rowUse a ruler to follow the row.
Across noonCount on through 12:00.

faq.q: What does CAPS Grade 6 say about time?
faq.a: Read, tell and write time in 12-hour and 24-hour formats, use calendars and timetables, calculate time intervals, and convert between units of time from seconds to centuries.

faq.q: How many minutes are in 2,5 hours?

faq.a: A plan of a trip with times and places.

items.q: How many years are in 9 decades?
items.e: 1 decade = 10 years, so 9 decades = 90 years.

items.q: A baobab tree is 3 centuries, 1 decade and 7 years old. How many years old is it?
How many years are in 3 centuries?
items.e: 1 century = 100 years, so 3 centuries = 300 years.

items.q: 500 years is how many centuries?
items.e: 1 century = 100 years. 500 ÷ 100 = 5 centuries.

items.q: 345 seconds = ☐ minutes ☐ seconds
items.e: 5 × 60 = 300, with 45 seconds left: 5 minutes 45 seconds.

items.q: 180 seconds = ☐ minutes ☐ seconds
items.e: 3 × 60 = 180, with 0 seconds left: 3 minutes.

items.q: 260 seconds = ☐ minutes ☐ seconds
items.e: 4 × 60 = 240, with 20 seconds left: 4 minutes 20 seconds.

items.q: A farmhouse is 3 centuries, 6 decades and 7 years old. How many years old is it?
How many seconds are in 5 minutes 45 seconds?
items.e: 5 × 60 = 300 seconds and 300 + 45 = 345 seconds.

items.q: A farmhouse is 3 centuries, 5 decades and 8 years old. How many years old is it?
Which is the same as 2,5 hours?
items.e: 0,5 hours is half an hour, and half of 60 minutes is 30 minutes. So 2,5 hours = 2 hours 30 minutes. 2 hours 50 minutes treats an hour as 100 minutes.

items.q: Convert. 1,5 hours = ☐ minutes
items.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes. Multiply: 1,5 × 60 = 90, so 1,5 hours = 90 minutes (60 + 30).

items.q: Convert. 0,25 hours = ☐ minutes
items.e: 0,25 is one quarter. A quarter of 60 minutes is 60 ÷ 4 = 15 minutes. (0,25 × 60 = 15.)

items.q: Convert. 2,5 minutes = ☐ seconds
items.e: 1 minute = 60 seconds. Multiply: 2,5 × 60 = 150, so 2,5 minutes = 150 seconds (120 + 30).

items.q: Convert. 1 hour = ☐ seconds
items.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes and 1 minute = 60 seconds. 60 × 60 = 3 600, so 1 hour = 3 600 seconds.

items.q: Convert. 0,2 hours = ☐ minutes
items.e: 0,2 is two tenths. One tenth of 60 minutes is 60 ÷ 10 = 6 minutes, so two tenths is 2 × 6 = 12 minutes, not 20.

items.q: Convert. 4 days = ☐ hours
items.e: 1 day = 24 hours. Multiply: 4 × 24 = 96, so 4 days = 96 hours.

items.q: Convert. 72 hours = ☐ days
items.e: 1 day = 24 hours. Hours to days: divide. 72 ÷ 24 = 3, so 72 hours = 3 days. Do not divide by 10 (that gives 7,2).

items.q: Convert. 14 weeks = ☐ days
items.e: 1 week = 7 days. Multiply: 14 × 7 = 98, so 14 weeks = 98 days.

items.q: Convert. 63 days = ☐ weeks
items.e: 1 week = 7 days. Days to weeks: divide. 63 ÷ 7 = 9, so 63 days = 9 weeks.

items.e: 10:30 + 6 hours 35 minutes = 17:05.
